newsitem.title: USA: Delta Petroleum hires financial consultant.
newsitem.headline: Delta Petroleum hires financial consultant.

text.p: Delta Petroleum Corp said it hired Barber & Bronson Inc's BC Capital Corp unit as a financial consultant to advise it on business strategies, including joint ventures, mergers and acquisitions.
The company did not provide further details. Officials there were not immediately available to comment.
Delta Petroleum is an oil and gas exploration and development company based in Denver.
Its current business plan includes continued development of its properties in Wyoming's Wind River Basin, Oklahoma's Anadarko Basin, and Colorado's Piceance Basin, it said.
